name: Alien crew
source: Ancient Aliens series kit (13 Nov 2026): BOARD.md sections 1-2, DESIGNS.md section 1, task T5; the look target is the three approved panel sheets (ancient-aliens-01-sheet-1..3.png)
personality: The alien crew potato: the series' recurring co-star. Small, round, cheerful, never says a word anyone understands, guides the stone blocks with flat palms. Clearly not one of the golden cast: blue-grey skin, teal eyes, an orange work coverall, two rubbery antennae (proposal until Jonny has seen it).
notes: Costume type aliencrew, variant crew (engine/page/costumes-aliens.js): antennae, burnt-orange coverall with a cream collar ring, zip, chest pocket and knee patches, cream gloves and stubby boots. Same cast skeleton as Chip (potato rig, 3-finger glove hands).
